newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FORINT A SHADE FIRMER VS DLR, ECU FUTURES POPULAR.
newsitem.headline: FORINT A SHADE FIRMER VS DLR, ECU FUTURES POPULAR.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed slightly firmer against the dollar at 151.22/27 in calm trade on Budapest's interbank forex market, dealers said.

"It was a quieter day than yesterday," said Ervin Csengeri of Inter-Europa Bank. "The forint moved up to 35 points weaker than the bid which provoked lots of offers, bringing it back to around 20 pips."
The forint opened on Thursday at 151.30. The national bank's resistance level stood at 151.11 at the close.
Csengeri predicted a similar pattern for Friday. "The forint could move up to 50 pips away from the bid before we see another spate of foreign currency selling," he said.
Currency futures turnover on the Budapest Commodity Exchange was relatively high at 4.6 billion forints, 60 percent of which was for the Ecu.
The Ecu, dollar, mark and yen all fell for most contracts.
